sourceClaims.claim: Messages.svg establishes a message composition with an editing area, text-editor controls, attachments and an action region
semantic regions, native textarea integration, responsive reflow and public state hooks are repository decisions

Composer and File Upload compose File Row at a preferred 229px width matching current Comment Feed, shrinking in narrow containers without growing into spare space; existing source-derived file SVGs and accessible supporting metadata color are reused.

evidence.source-integrity: pass: Messages.svg source facts and repository decisions are recorded separately and enforced by focused source tests
evidence.structural-contract: pass: independent root, nested regions, states, docs and export are asserted
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: the consumer-owned submit flow executes from the native textarea composition
evidence.accessibility: pass: labelled native editing surface, toolbar semantics, named commands, invalid association and scoped axe scan are browser-checked
evidence.focused-visual: pass: attachment-composition browser checks compare 229x55 cards, 38px visuals, 12px radius and metadata paint with Comment Feed; focused desktop and 220px attachment crops are inspected
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Data Workspace owns formatting and submission state while consuming only public CSS and native semantics
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: long localized/unbroken attachment names ellipsize inside 220px cards at 200-percent root text; visuals and existing actions remain contained; three selected files wrap without growing

staticVisual: pass: source, disabled, read-only and invalid fixtures retain explicit audit roots
realInteractionVisual: pass: textarea focus changes the composed frame border through focus-within
runtimeBehavior: pass: consumer submit command updates application-owned status without a library controller

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: 2026-09-09 affected desktop and narrow attachment crops inspected against Comments/Document SVG crops; focus-visible, keyboard removal and unchanged component state flows exercised in focused browser coverage

acceptedDeviations.scope: pre-existing focused screenshots for six components outside Composer and Rich Text Toolbar
acceptedDeviations.evidence: full Playwright run reports nine failures across eight unchanged snapshots; calendar-grid-header-rows.png reproduces on detached clean origin/main at cb27a06 with the exact same 1092-pixel delta, while all 11 Composer and consumer browser checks pass
acceptedDeviations.reason: resolving the shared rendering/snapshot contract is outside this component PR and requires a cross-component decision

knownLimitations: editing, formatting, validation, attachment lifecycle, submission, persistence and live-region policy are consumer-owned
the component supplies presentation and semantic integration guidance, not an editor engine
